prompt:
Full-fidelity desktop website homepage screenshot, first viewport, 1536x1024 landscape, flat front-on browser view (no device frame, no perspective). The homepage of LumiVerse, a senior AI product studio in Zagreb. Direction "Machined Instrument": the entire page is one soft-touch anodised slate aluminium panel (base #3A3D42, highlight bevel edges #4A4E54, shadow recesses #25272B), with crisp precision-milled recesses and raised keys lit from the top left. Real machined hardware neumorphism, sharp small-radius chamfers, not soft blobs. Engraved legends in light grey #9A9EA5, main text #F2F2F0. Exactly one colour accent: coral #FF4D4D, used only on the primary key and one selected legend. Strict module grid, every panel snaps to it. Typeface: industrial grotesk like Archivo, expanded wide for the headline, condensed uppercase for engraved labels. No neon glow, no gradients other than physical lighting, no purple.

Regions top to bottom, left to right:
1. Slim top bar milled into the panel, about 6% of height: left the wordmark "LumiVerse" with a small coral dot; centre small engraved condensed caps nav labels "WORK   SERVICES   RESEARCH   STUDIO   CONTACT"; right a two-position mechanical toggle switch "EN | HR" with EN selected.
2. Left 55% of the viewport below the bar: a large milled recess holding the headline in large expanded grotesk, white #F2F2F0, three lines exactly: "Ambitious AI," / "checked before" / "it ships." Below it one line of smaller grey text: "Senior AI studio in Zagreb. We build products, and the checks that make them safe to ship." Below that two hardware keys side by side: a raised coral #FF4D4D key with white label "Start a Project →", and a recessed slate grey key labelled "See the work".
3. Right 45%: a recessed instrument display window with a dark bezel, showing a realistic website screenshot inside: a warm-toned cream and terracotta Croatian webshop page with product tiles, and an open AI assistant chat widget in the lower right titled "Moj Kolega" with a few chat bubbles. Under the display, a row of three detented selector keys labelled in condensed caps "MOJ KOLEGA", "BRIDJ", "AIR-LASER"; the first key is pressed in deeper with its legend lit coral, the other two are raised with grey legends.
4. Bottom strip across the full width, about 10% of height: an engraved scale readout row with fine tick marks and three small measured stats in condensed caps: "17 SERVICES · BRIDJ", "24/7 · MOJ KOLEGA", "49-PAGE STUDY · AIR-LASER".

All text crisp, correctly spelled and readable. Premium, quiet, precise studio website; it must read unmistakably as a website homepage, not a poster or product photo.
